title: XP summaries list v1
description: Body of GET /api/xp: the xp-summary of every bot binding that has at least one XP entry, in ascending bindingId order, at most 500. A bot with no entry is simply absent and reads as 0 XP at level 1; the client joins this list to the roster by bindingId. There is no cursor because a single install has few bots with XP. asOfMs is the server time the list was read.
